name: Swinburne University of Technology - Sarawak

programmes.name: Civil Engineering
programmes.about: A four-year honours engineering degree in the design, construction and maintenance of buildings, bridges, water systems and transport networks.
programmes.overview: Students complete 32 units: core engineering units, an 18-unit civil major, four electives and two final-year capstone projects. A 12-week approved industrial placement is required before the last semester. Intakes are February and September.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma 26 points (out of 6 subjects) in the engineering column; the table also lists Advanced Maths plus Physics or Chemistry as a prerequisite.
programmes.selectionNote: Grade-based; prerequisite subjects apply. English: IELTS 6.0 with no band below 6.0.

flagshipSource.title: Swinburne Sarawak Civil Engineering (Honours): BEM and Engineers Australia pathways

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: A three-year software-focused computing degree with specialisations in software development, cybersecurity or internet of things.
programmes.overview: Students complete 24 units: 8 core units covering programming, web technology, networks and two computing projects, 8 in a major (Software Development or Cybersecurity, for example) and 8 other units. The degree is accredited by the Australian Computer Society at professional level. Intakes are March and September.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma 24 points (out of 6 subjects); the table lists Maths as a prerequisite.
programmes.selectionNote: Grade-based; prerequisite subjects apply. English: IELTS 6.0 with no band below 6.0.

flagshipSource.title: Swinburne Sarawak Bachelor of Computer Science: ACS-accredited

summary: Swinburne's Kuching campus awarding Swinburne degrees in engineering, computing, business, design and science.

handoff.label: Degrees and double degrees at Swinburne Sarawak

ib.text: IB Diploma minimum: 24 points out of 6 subjects for most degrees, 26 for the engineering columns (Civil is 26). Subject prerequisites apply. Course Results alone are not addressed.

languageOfInstruction.note: Swinburne requires IELTS 6.0 (no band below 6.0) or equivalent for all undergraduate majors.

faculties.name: Engineering
faculties.line: Honours degrees in civil, chemical, electrical and electronic, mechanical, robotics and software engineering, plus double degrees.

faculties.name: Computing
faculties.line: Computer Science, Information and Communication Technology, Cyber Security and Data Science.

faculties.name: Business
faculties.line: Bachelor of Business majors including accounting, finance, marketing and management.

faculties.name: Design, media and science
faculties.line: Design, Multimedia Design, Media and Communication, Biotechnology and Environmental Science.

notes: No 2027 application or closing dates are published on the pages read; check the online application before planning. Intakes shown on the course pages are February (engineering) and March (computing), plus September.
IB column mapping: the academic requirement table gives 24 or 26 points across ten undergraduate columns; the engineering columns are 26. Confirm your degree with Swinburne before relying on it.

Fees: Civil Engineering shows RM 45,024 for international students (RM 35,560 Malaysian) as 'annual'. Computer Science shows RM 130,200 international (RM 99,840 Malaysian) with no period. Neither page states a year, and prices exclude SST.

Recognition: Civil Engineering graduates are eligible to register as Graduate Engineers with the Board of Engineers Malaysia and apply to the Institution of Engineers Malaysia and Engineers Australia. Computer Science is accredited by the Australian Computer Society.
English: IELTS 6.0 with no band below 6.0, or TOEFL iBT 64 (minimums apply by skill), for all undergraduate majors. The page does not say whether IB English waives the test.
Only two of 33 degrees and double degrees are detailed; the engineering and business pages list others. Honours engineering degrees run four years and double degrees five.
